Commentary.Commentary: That's it from this game and this series. England won the T20I series and India have won the one-off Test. We hope you enjoyed our company, until next time, goodbye and take care.

Harmanpreet Kaur says she is very happy with the win. Adds they wanted to win it from the start and were well prepared. Mentions they executed their plans well. Ends by saying she is proud of her side.
Player of the Match, Deepti Sharma says she is very pleased. Adds she was waiting for this day. Mentions they executed their plans well and hit the right spots which helped them win this game.

Heather Knight says they were outplayed. Adds India batted and bowled really well. Reckons India were better with the ball in this innings. Also says they did not bat well and there is a lot to learn for them.

England ended up conceding a lead of over 300. India did not enforce the follow on and gave England a massive target. However, it took the Indians just the one session to bowl the English out again and yet again, Sharma was the star with the ball.

Deepti Sharma was the star in the first innings picking up a fifer. Natalie Sciver-Brunt was the only English batter who crossed the 20-run mark. The rest failed to do so. Due to that performance with the bat, England were well behind in the game.

That's a massive win for the Indians. What a dominant performance from them to beat a strong English side. They dominated the game right from Day 1. First, it was a combined effort from their batters to post a good first innings score and then it was all about their bowlers.
